title: Waterlines in Flux: Aerial Hydrology of the Rhine River Basin
author: Integrational e.V. Youth Media Lab
summary: Documenting extreme seasonal water level fluctuations and receding gravel beds along the Rhine River using drone aerial imaging, examining riparian ecosystem resilience and flood protection.
content: Over recent years, European waterways have experienced historic climatic fluctuations. Through the Green Horizon project, young participants in Bonn investigate how drone aerial imaging documents shoreline recession, low-water navigation impacts, and the vitality of alluvial wetlands along the Rhine.
highlights: Aerial drone mapping of alluvial gravel bars and drying riverbanks
Interviews with regional environmental activists and hydrological experts
Analysis of rising river levels and flood defence mechanisms in North Rhine-Westphalia

title: Canopy Dieback & Forest Recovery in the Eifel & Siebengebirge
author: Integrational e.V. Youth Media Lab
summary: Drone-assisted aerial surveillance tracking summer drought stress, bark beetle spread, and reforestation initiatives across mixed European woodlands.
content: Examining local deforestation and heat stress in rural woodlands near Bonn. Youth participants employ aerial cameras to compare dying spruce monocultures with diverse native broadleaf restoration areas.
highlights: High-angle crown density assessment of regional woodlands
Ground interviews with municipal foresters on climate resilience
Youth reflections on intergenerational responsibility for forest preservation

title: The Shrinking Salt Flat: Drone Perspectives on Central Anatolia
location: Lake Tuz Basin & Konya Closed Basin, Türkiye
author: IESA Youth Media Team
summary: Exploring the rapid hydrological drying of Lake Tuz and the Konya Closed Basin through high-altitude aerial sweeps, highlighting flamingo nesting sanctuaries and groundwater depletion.
content: Lake Tuz, one of the world's largest hypersaline lakes and a critical breeding haven for the Greater Flamingo, is experiencing severe climatic desiccation. Turkish youth teams record dramatic aerial footage of salt crust expansion and receding water lines to inspire sustainable water stewardship.
highlights: Aerial sweeps of polygonal salt crystallization and receding shorelines
Documentation of fragile flamingo nesting zones vulnerable to drought
Community interviews on agricultural groundwater extraction and climate adaptation

title: Mediterranean Coastlines: Erosion, Agriculture & Heat in Mersin
location: Mersin Coastal Plain & Çukurova Delta, Türkiye
author: IESA Youth Media Team
summary: Aerial surveys of the eastern Mediterranean coastline examining coastal erosion, microclimate alterations, and heat stress on citrus agriculture.
content: IESA youth participants in Mersin document the interface between intensive agriculture and sensitive coastal habitats, showing how changing precipitation patterns influence farming livelihoods and coastal wetlands.
highlights: Drone tracking of shoreline erosion along the eastern Mediterranean
Aerial documentation of agricultural water use and greenhouse expansion
Interviews with local farmers and youth volunteers engaged in beach clean-ups

title: Canopy Guardians: Monitoring Virgin Forests in the Carpathians
author: Asociatia Empower Plus Media Lab
summary: Deploying aerial imaging across steep mountain valleys to monitor primeval beech forest canopies, biodiversity corridors, and drought-induced dieback.
content: The Carpathian Mountains hold Europe's most extensive virgin forest systems. Romanian youth volunteers employ drone cameras to survey dense canopy health across inaccessible ridge terrain, contrasting intact old-growth forests with areas affected by climatic stress and logging.
highlights: 360° aerial panorama capture for the Green Horizon VR Exhibition on Artsteps
Comparative visual inventory of old-growth versus fragmented forest perimeters

title: Urban Heat & Waterways: Documenting the Dâmbovița River
author: Asociatia Empower Plus Media Lab
summary: Aerial perspectives on urban heat islands, concrete riverbanks, and green corridor revitalisation in the Romanian capital.
content: Empower Plus youth participants explore Bucharest's urban ecosystem, using aerial views of the Dâmbovița River to demonstrate how urban green-blue corridors mitigate extreme summer heat waves.
highlights: Drone flights over urban water axes and green infrastructure corridors
Thermal differences between concrete urban cores and vegetated parks
Youth activism proposals for urban biodiversity and eco-friendly city planning
